node_library.readAFlightControllerParameterLive: Read a flight controller parameter live (e.g. CAM1_TRIGG_DIST). Returns 0 if the parameter does not exist.
node_library.readTheDigitalLevelOfA: Read the digital level of a GPIO pin. Wire a Pin input to set it from a parameter, or use the Pin property. Polled once per tick: pulses shorter than the run interval are missed, use Pulse Input (interrupt) for those.
node_library.catchShortPulsesEGA: Catch short pulses (e.g. a 1-2 ms camera hotshoe pulse) on a GPIO pin via hardware interrupt. The pulse width is latched between ticks, so slow polling still sees it. The pin needs SERVOx_FUNCTION = -1 and must not be shared with CAM1_FEEDBAK_PIN (whoever attaches first owns the interrupt).

node_library.aFixedValueNumberStringOr: A fixed value (number, string, or boolean)
